name: Our Summer Holiday
source: A group of friends decide what to do with their spare time over summer holidays. What will they decide to do? You decide and try to find the best choices that these friends should take. [From [url=http://www.mybubbleteatime.com/p/projects.html]My Bubbletea Time[/url]]
